items.note: Every New Capabilities bullet must name a kebab-case capability path (segments of lowercase alphanumerics joined by hyphens, optionally nested with '/'). Whether the path follows the project's existing spec organization is a judgment call and is not checked.

sources.quote: Use kebab-case for path segments you introduce (e.g., user-auth or identity/user-auth) that follow the project's existing spec organization.
- `<capability-path>`: <brief description of what this capability covers>

items.note: Each Modified Capabilities entry must equal a capability directory under openspec/specs/ at BASE_SHA. No selector maps base_paths (file paths like openspec/specs/<cap>/spec.md) to capability paths, so cross_ref cannot compare them directly.

sources.quote: Use the exact existing path under openspec/specs/.

unitemized.reason: This is a permission, not an obligation: Modified Capabilities may be left empty when no requirement changes. Leftover template placeholders are already caught by the compiled skeleton checks, and nothing observable ties an empty section to a run event.

.openspec.yaml is not a declared artifact, so no kind or predicate can read its skip_specs key. The condition (no new or modified capabilities) could be expressed, but the required check on .openspec.yaml cannot.
